output.reason: The cited item [ev-c85e20a4d636] is just a metric name, but it sits in the list under the section intro [ev-1f419676f177], which says what the change is. Metrics that start with `cortex_` now start with `loki_` in this release, so this metric becomes `loki_prometheus_notifications_queue_length`. That applies to any deployment where `metrics_namespace` is still the default `loki`, and setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. The setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release, after which the prefix will always be `loki`. Together this gives the subject (this metric), the change (rename via the prefix, before and after stated), who is exposed (deployments that don't set `metrics_namespace: cortex`) and the consequence (the metric is no longer published under its old `cortex_` name).
